message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: They created a fake website mimicking Supreme People's Procuratorate, with ability to input personal info and backend view. They knew it could be used for fraud. They provided site to accomplice, got 10k. They also provided maintenance. The accomplice used site to phish victim, obtained 5.69 million. The defendants are charged with fraud (诈骗罪) as per description. Also possibly "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (providing technical support for fraud). In Chinese criminal law, creating phishing website is "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 286). Also could be "诈骗罪" as principal? They are accomplices to fraud, maybe "诈骗罪" as从犯. The examples show they label as "诈骗". In earlier examples, they gave "诈骗;组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" etc. For similar case of providing website for fraud, they might label as "诈骗" only. The prompt: "构成诈骗罪". So answer: 诈骗. Possibly also "非法获取公民个人信息"? They collected personal data but for fraud. But main is 诈骗. So output single crime.

Format: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
